text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Waaaaay~♪

text_block_list.name: Young Woman
text_block_list.text: Helios! Brought someone new along today, huh? A buddy of yours?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yep! Name's Trai-pi! We super tight~☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ever since our eyes locked! Total wavelength sync, no cap☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Oh! Here it comes, here it comes~~! This track slaps so hard! C'mon, let's dance!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Just like this! Ride that groove~... Catch the vibe! Go with the flow!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Just go boom-boom♪ with the beat, ya feel me?! If that's tricky, just copy my moves! Freezing up is total buzzkill territory~
If I ruin the mood, I might lose my chance to talk with her. Besides, when in Rome...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hyuuu, that's the spirit~☆ Trai-pi's getting into it, lookin' lit☆ Team Heli-T is about to tear the floor up!
And just like that, I was swept into Daitaku Helios's wild pace... Or perhaps I was simply drawn in, like a moth to a flame――

text_block_list.name: Shopper A
text_block_list.text: ―So, regarding the next community round-table! The association head suggested we do a potluck picnic!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Sounds hype as heck~! Though whenever I cook, everything turns to charcoal! If ya need extra crunch and bitterness, leave it to me!☆

text_block_list.name: Shopper A
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, a little charring just gives it character! ...Or so they say! Things got so much livelier ever since Helios-chan started joining in.

text_block_list.name: Shopper B
text_block_list.text: Team-ups with other associations going smooth too. Picnic sounds packed!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hyuuu～♪ Forget park, rent dome! Fireside chat in dome sounds wild☆

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: True that☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ―Line up kiddie pools! Fake beach for Gramps and Granny, count me in!

text_block_list.name: Elder Man
text_block_list.text: Fufu, sounds fun. Summer comes even for old man like me.

text_block_list.name: Small Child
text_block_list.text: Helios-chan, wanna help too! Gonna bring school friends～ ehehe♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: We～i, everyone welcome☆ Whole world my bestie-!
Smiles gathered around Daitaku Helios. Because she always smiled…… from bottom of heart―

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ah～ Good times, good times☆ Today extra lit!
Spending day with her brought understanding. Endless brightness, drawn like Sun. But still……
Why Tracen Academy for someone enjoying life this much…… big reason hidden somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Alright, grand finale! Time to race～!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ―Yooooo. Let's get hype～☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Heck is that? Sounds rough～ hilarious!
choice_data_list: Didn't you run a mock race yesterday?
Didn't you run a mock race yesterday?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Day ain't done without run. Wrap up with most fun thing, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: 'Course! Blast today, but nothin' beats race☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Go all out, blood pumps! Wild clash of vibes! Feels insane～☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wait…… wild! Never knew races ruled? Must be why you asked, right?

text_block_list.name: Helios' Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Heeey, all set-. Helios, gate in too～.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ……No choice☆ Hey～! Running piggyback with this one!

text_block_list.name: Helios' Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Huuuh～～～?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hyuu～～～～! Full blast――――!
Race started carrying me forcibly! Full speed from start gate―

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ahahaa! Ain't scary! Feel with whole body! Best thing eeeeeeeever～～～～!
Urged by words, steeled self, opened eyes. Wind, breath, footfalls, heartbeat…… hit all at once―

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Weeeee～～～～～i! Wild, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Anything better than this? Racing rules! Totally hooked～～☆
Not indifferent to outcome. Just loved running…… and races from bottom of heart. Total free spirit―

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ―Dead last again? Tragic much?
choice_data_list: I mean, you were carrying a person……

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Truth☆ Still lit though! Told ya racing rules, right?
Clung for dear life, wouldn't call it fun…… but understood her heart. And own feelings……
Wanted to cheer sunny, ultra-free girl. Stripped of noise, only simple feeling remained.
―Wasteful though. "Fun win or lose" mindset missed joy of victory.
choice_data_list: (For her, it'll be even more fun)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: One more round! No piggyback this time! Sounds hype, right?

text_block_list.name: Helios' Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Eh～? No way! Can't run multi-days back to back!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Then Trai-pi, I choose you! Use Parallel Running!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Race was awesome, right? Own two feet now～ battle it out with me～☆ Gate in, wei!
